title: mac-slot and sim-run each carry the same waiter-queue logic (about 19 lines)
evidence: tools/mac-slot.sh and ios/scripts/sim-run.sh (PR 1428) both queue waiters the same way (PR 1427 review R4, owner's ruling 2026-11-12): a marker locked on fd 7 under queue.*, renamed to waiting.*.<ms>.<pid>; ahead() probes each earlier marker with an instant lockf on fd 8 and removes one it can lock; the 0.2 s wait loop with fds 7 and 9 closed; the marker removed and fd 7 closed once the lock is taken. Lines: ahead() 9 in mac-slot, 10 in sim-run; marker setup 4 each; wait loop 4 each; cleanup 2 and 3. A fix to one (R4 and R5 came one script at a time) must be made by hand in the other. Not refactored: noted only
